title.description: Product name shown to the buyer, without the store name

price.description: Current price of the selected or default variant, with its currency

availability.description: Whether the selected or default variant can be bought now

url.description: Canonical URL of the product page

image_url.description: URL of the main product image

brand.description: Brand or manufacturer name of the product

sku.description: The seller's stock keeping unit for the selected or default variant

gtin.description: GS1 trade item number (GTIN-8, -12, -13 or -14) of the selected or default variant
